verdict.rationale: Tavily ships SDKs (Python/JS) designed explicitly for LLM/agent consumption (qna_search 'perfect for usage by LLMs', get_search_context for direct RAG feeding), plus an official MCP server compatible with any MCP client for tool-call integration, and clear API reference/OpenAPI-style endpoint docs for search/extract/crawl/map/research. missing for 10: no discoverable OpenAPI/JSON schema spec (probe found 404s) and no explicit named framework integrations (e.g., LangChain/LlamaIndex tool classes) cited in evidence.
